original_turn.question: Tesla目前面临哪些主要风险？包括监管、竞争和供应链方面。
original_turn.search_summary: Key risks: (1) EU tariffs on China-made EVs raised to 45% — Tesla exports from Shanghai impacted. (2) BYD surpassed Tesla in global BEV sales in Q4 2024. (3) NHTSA investigating 2.4M vehicles over Full Self-Driving incidents. (4) Lithium prices volatile — key battery material. (5) Union pressure at German Gigafactory. (6) Musk's political activities creating brand reputation risk in key markets.
original_turn.answer: 特斯拉面临六大主要风险。第一，欧盟对中国产电动车关税提至45%，影响上海工厂出口。第二，比亚迪2024年Q4纯电销量已超越特斯拉。第三，NHTSA正在调查240万辆配备FSD的车辆。第四，锂电池原材料锂价格波动大。第五，德国超级工厂面临工会组织压力。第六，马斯克的政治活动在欧洲等关键市场造成品牌声誉风险。
